entry.title: MPC DJ FX 2 3.1.6
entry.summary: Fixes 3.1.5, where the QR could not be opened by a finger. `#bar` is `pointer-events: none` so swipes reach the canvas; the `PAIR …` span inherited it, so a real tap hit the canvas and the QR never appeared. The line now opts back in (`pointer-events: auto`), as the other two ports already did. Checked with hit-testing rather than `element.click()`: `elementFromPoint` at the line's real position returned `<canvas>` before and `<span id=pair>` after, and a click there toggles the QR `none → block

entry.title: MPC DJ FX 2 3.1.5
entry.summary: Tapping **PAIR** on the phone page now shows the pairing QR (`/qr.svg`). Before this, the page printed its own address but never revealed the code, so a second phone still had to type the URL. - The handler resolves the `` on click — it sits after the page script, and a top-level `getElementById` returned null there (the first attempt was a silent no-op). - `/qr.svg` is byte-identical to an independent `qrcodegen` run of the plugin's own `/state.url`; the toggle was checked in a real browse

entry.title: MPC DJ FX 2 3.1.4
entry.summary: Companion screen gains a **pairing QR** at `/qr.svg`: tap the `PAIR` line in the panel and scan it from a second phone instead of typing the address. The QR is generated from the plugin's own interface address at request time. Encoder: Project Nayuki's qrcodegen (MIT, pinned), vendored - nothing fetched at runtime.

entry.title: MPC DJ FX 2 3.1.3
entry.summary: **The plugin now serves its own panel** on the LAN, port 8102: four faces (MACRO, FILTER, REPEAT, DELAY), read and write, one browser tab per device. `DJF2_HTTP=0` disables the listener, `DJF2_HTTP_RW=0` makes it read-only, and writes need an `X-DJF2: 1` header so another web page cannot post to it. **Switches.** The two-state controls (SYNC, PONG, FILL, MODE, LIMITER, EQ CURVE) never registered a touch: they were drawn in a strip outside the reachable area of the 1280x628 screen. entry.title: MPC DJ FX 2 3.1.2
entry.summary: Vendor name change: the plugin now ships under **LarryDaimond** (was `MPCDJ`), so it installs into `/sdcard/Synths/LarryDaimond - VST - MPC DJ FX 2/` and the skins carry the new name. The uid is unchanged, so a saved project and an existing install keep working: `install.sh` replaces the old entry. The old `MPCDJ - VST - MPC DJ FX 2` folder and its `Insert Effects/MPCDJ - ...` preset folder are left behind and can be deleted by hand. All three interfaces (classic / studio / rack) are in this one
